what: one edge flange feature whose four edges carry 75, 90, 105 and 120 degrees and heights 38.6, 38.6, 30 and 25, with corners between unequal angles closed, unfolded
method: a flange of angle th, outer leg length Hf (height, from the virtual sharp along the flange) bends with allowance BA = th(R+Kt) and bend deduction BD = 2(R+t)tan(th/2) - BA; unfolded it lies in the base's plane and reaches Hf - BD beyond the base's edge. T = 2, R = 1, K = 0.5. BD = 1.9860, 2.8584, 4.1542, 6.2035 for 75, 90, 105, 120 degrees, so the flat reaches 36.6140 below, 35.7416 right of, 25.8458 above and 18.7965 left of the 120 x 90 base
